_about: Central performance budgets for AI Gateway. Calibrated from the local baseline (docs/local-readiness/). Budgets are environment-specific: these values are for a local dev box. Enforcement is split: the end-to-end API/resource/DB budgets are checked by cmd/perf (existing load harness); the micro-benchmark regression policy is enforced by cmd/perfgate against perf/baseline.json. See perf/README.md for rationale.

regression._about: Used by cmd/perfgate to compare the current micro-benchmark run against perf/baseline.json. Allocations and bytes are deterministic (no run-to-run noise), so their thresholds are strict; ns/op is noisy on a shared box, so its threshold is looser and sub-noise-floor benchmarks are skipped.
